'''Bahzel''' was a legendary [[Artist/Legends|artist]] who created the [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] ''[[Bothan Buff]]'' and ''[[Bothan Beauty]]''. This artist was also rumored to have painted ''[[Still Life - Kite Plant]]''.<ref name="An Empire Divided">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bahzel's singular appearance in [[canon]] is a mention of being the creator of the three paintings mentioned in this article in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games#Massive multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment.
